articleTitle: A Survey of Text Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: When natural language processing (NLP) technology is applied to industrial internet, problems such as lack of data and imbalance of data are often encountered. In order to improve the accuracy and robustness of the model, text data augmentation was proposed to expand data. Data augmentation is widely used in computer vision. For example, the semantics of the image will not be changed if the image is rotated several degrees or converted to gray level. However, augmentation of text data in NLP is pretty rare. Data augmentation is a low-cost means to expand the amount of data and improve the effect of the model, which has a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection Method Based on GAN Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: The existing network intrusion detection methods have less label samples in the training process, and the detection accuracy is not high. In order to solve this problem, this paper designs a network intrusion detection method based on the GAN model by using the adversarial idea contained in the GAN. The model enhances the original training set by continuously generating samples, which expanding the label sample set. In order to realize the multi-classification of samples, this paper transforms the previous binary classification model of the generated adversarial network into a supervised learning multi-classification model. The loss function of training is redefined, so that the corresponding training method and parameter setting are obtained. Under the same experimental conditions, several performance indicators are used to compare the detection ability of the proposed method, the original classification model and other models. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper is more stable, robust, accurate detection rate, has good generalization ability, and can effectively realize network intrusion detection.

articleTitle: Loan Default Prediction with Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Loan business is one of the major income sources for bank. However, loan default problem is a major issue for loan business. With the rise of big data era and the development of machine learning techniques, nowadays we have more options for classifying and predicting loan default, other than manual processing. With a real-world dataset from a prestigious international bank, we demonstrate that the AdaBoost model can achieve a 100% accuracy for predicting loan default, outperforming other models including XGBoost, random forest, k nearest neighbors, and multilayer perceptrons. Our result shows the promising application of machine learning techniques in the financial industry.

articleTitle: 6G Is Coming : Discussion on Key Candidate Technologies and Application Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: 5G construction is in the ascendant and at the same time the construction and layout of 6G have been recently started. In the 6G era, many new technologies and new methods will be applied, and 6G will also meet new application scenarios and usage requirements. This paper introduces and analyzes the key candidate technologies and application scenarios brought by the sixth-generation mobile communication, which has construction and guiding significance.

articleTitle: A Small Sample DDoS Attack Detection Method Based on Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: When using deep learning for DDoS attack detection, there is a general degradation in detection performance due to small sample size. This paper proposes a small-sample DDoS attack detection method based on deep transfer learning. First, deep learning techniques are used to train several neural networks that can be used for transfer in DDoS attacks with sufficient samples. Then we design a transferability metric to compare the transfer performance of different networks. With this metric, the network with the best transfer performance can be selected among the four networks. Then for a small sample of DDoS attacks, this paper demonstrates that the deep learning detection technique brings deterioration in performance, with the detection performance dropping from 99.28% to 67%. Finally, we end up with a 20.8% improvement in detection performance by deep transfer of the 8LANN network in the target domain. The experiment shows that the detection method based on deep transfer learning proposed in this paper can well improve the performance deterioration of deep learning techniques for small sample DDoS attack detection.

articleTitle: Malware Detection based on Cascading XGBoost and Cost Sensitive
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Malware which in general are programs that developed for malicious purpose can be used to change or destroy data, run destructive or intrusive programs, and steal personal or other sensitive information. Malware are becoming more and more complex by keeping evolving with technology development. Newly emerged malware has enhanced the ability of survival and anti-detection, and have become a serious safety problem for corporations, government agencies, and individuals. Most previous researches about malware detection using machine learning are based on balanced samples. However, the proportion of benign code and malicious code in real program is extremely unbalanced. In this paper, we propose a malware detection method based on three-tier cascading XGBoost and cost sensitive to improve the ability to deal with unbalanced data. In this model, we extract the API called by PE file to construct the features and use three-tier cascading XGBoost to balance the data and classify. The result of the experiment indicate that this method has high accuracy for malicious code detection of unbalanced samples.

articleTitle: A design of SD-WAN-oriented wide area network access
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: This article proposes a converged SD-WAN architecture for the lack of flexibility of the existing SD-WAN architecture. The architecture takes the SDN controller as the core of the entire SD-WAN and deploys it in the corporate headquarters. Different from other SDN-WAN solutions, the forwarding layer of the integrated SD-WAN architecture uses Customer Premise Equipment (CPE)and OpenFlow switches as the main equipment to complete data forwarding and receiving functions.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: At present, network intrusion in the cloud environment is characterized by variability, invisibility and unpredictability, which makes network intrusion detection increasingly difficult, and traditional intrusion detection system is hard to meet the actual needs. A network intrusion detection system is proposed for cloud computing environment in this paper. C4.5 in the decision tree is used as the algorithm to build an intrusion detection model. This paper uses random forest algorithm to construct the intrusion detection model, and uses tcpdump tool and data mining technology to collect the network traffic data of different network levels of each cloud server in real time Finally the experimental results show that the system can effectively shorten the training time and test time of intrusion detection, and the detection accuracy is up to 99.71%, which achieves the effect of real-time monitoring and discovery of network intrusion behavior, and has good application value.

articleTitle: A Decentralized Secure Mailbox System based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Nowadays, the communication services provided by the e-mail system are used all over the world for formal communication and business negotiation. The traditional e-mail systems provide services based on their centralized servers. If the centralized servers are attacked, the confidential message and the private information will be leaked to the attacker. To this end, this paper uses blockchain technology to build a decentralized e-mail system with trust and accountability. To improve the PBFT algorithm which is widely-used for blockchain consensus and reduce the bad influence brought by the abnormal blockchain nodes, this work proposes a node quality control strategy for blockchain consensus nodes. Moreover, this paper designs the blockchain-based evidence storage module and dispute resolution module to serve our mailbox users. The experiment results show that the blockchain-based e-mail system proposed in this paper can achieve a high-quality consensus mechanism with the node quality control strategy and reduce the transaction delay time.

articleTitle: Summary of Research on Security and Privacy of Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Smart grid is the development direction of power system all over the world. With the deepening of the process of power marketization in the world, users' requirements for the reliability and security of smart grid are increasing. Smart grid equipment and information security is the premise to ensure the safe, efficient and robust operation of smart grid. This paper mainly describes the concept, characteristics, architecture, security problems and corresponding solutions of the smart grid, and introduces in detail the security risks hidden in the smart meter, wide area measurement system and on-line monitoring technology.

articleTitle: Short-time traffic flow forecast with weather characteristics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the traffic flow prediction model only focuses on the time dimension, which results in the model's low accuracy. In this paper, the three most influential weather features are extracted from the weather data through the principal component analysis (PCA). Weather features are extracted by PCA algorithm. The combined input of weather and time characteristics is compared with the input of time characteristics to obtain the simulation results. Experimental simulation results show that the RMSE and MAPE of the model decreased to 11.9844% and 7.1398 respectively when the extracted weather characteristics were used as the input of LSTM. The construction of the model can optimize the travel experience and facilitate the traffic department to grasp the traffic flow.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Clock Fault Injection for AES
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Traditional cryptography security often relies on the security of the cryptographic algorithm itself. However, in practice, cryptographic algorithms are always implemented based on software or hardware. In fault attack, attackers induce errors during encryption calculations to extract key information in embedded systems. Clock glitch injection poses a serious threat to cryptographic algorithms, which is a kind of fault attack. This paper proposes a built-in faulty clock generator integrated on FPGA to evaluate fault injection attacks and their impact on encryption modules. The platform generates glitches in a normal clock cycle, and can change the influence range of clock failures by accurately controlling the position and shape of the glitches. The research in this paper shows that the glitch can appear in any assigned cycle, and the width can be adjusted with increments of 0.14ns when the clock cycle is 20ns. This platform has great significance and value for standardizing the failure evaluation process of resource-constrained cryptosystems and building a unified security evaluation framework.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of Fatigue of Construction Workers by Heart Rate Monitoring Technology and Model Establishment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: In order to explore the law of construction workers' heart rate change in fatigue state, the heart rate was used as a parameter to build the evaluation calculation model.. Five healthy participants (male) were selected to imitate construction by engaging in bricklaying. 3 simulation platforms are designed to simulate the effect of repeated brick moving on fatigue life of masonry workers at different height walls. The results showed that the change of relative heart rate accords with "s" type. According the theory the average relative heart rate of the volunteers increased fastest in the early stage and higher than the other two platforms in the middle and high platform (simulated job at the height of the waist height of 86cm). The average relative rate of heart rate rising was relatively slow at the early stage of the low high platform (simulated at the knee height of 48CM). The average relative heart rate changes of the volunteers were not changed at the first and middle stages of the highest platform. The average relative heart rate was similar to the middle and high platform at a slow rate, and the average relative heart rate was similar to the middle and high platform. Using this model, the fatigue state of construction workers can be evaluated.

articleTitle: A design of three-band monopole antenna applied to 4G/5G
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: With the gradual commercialization of 5G, antenna equipment that can meet the requirements of multiple frequency hands is particularly important. For this reason, this paper proposes and designs a three-hand L-type monopole antenna suitable for 4G/5G communication. The antenna consists of three branches, including rectangular parasitic patches, floor and feeder lines. The antenna size is 16 x 30mm. Three L-shaped branches generate three resonance frequencies, covering the 2.6/ 3.5/4.8 frequency band. After testing, the impedance bandwidths of the three frequency bands are 180MHz, 250MHz and 1130MHz, and the antenna also has good omnidirectional characteristics and good impedance matching.

articleTitle: A Vulnerability Risk Assessment Method for Industrial Control System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Aiming at how to accurately assess the vulnerability risk of industrial control system, this paper proposes an algorithm for vulnerability risk assessment of industrial control system. This method firstly establishes the attack-defense game model of industrial control system and gives the expression of the attacker's maximum return expectation. The loss degree of the industrial control system after being attacked is calculated according to the three security attributes of the industrial control system. The vulnerability value is calculated by using the attacker's maximum return expectation and system loss degree. Then the expression of comprehensive connectivity between vulnerabilities is given according to vulnerability correlation graph and risk matrix. The own risk and associated risk of vulnerability are calculated by using vulnerability value and comprehensive connectivity between vulnerabilities, the vulnerability comprehensive risk is assessed finally. The example analysis shows that the method combined with the security attributes of industrial control system, not only considers the influence of mutual restriction factors of information security attack and defense sides, but also reflects the correlation between vulnerabilities. The method is feasible and effective, the results are objective and accurate. The method is used to evaluate the key vulnerability of industrial control system, it has the advantages of safety assessment and defense.

articleTitle: Research on the technology of artificial intelligence in computer network under the background of big data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: In order to create a safe computer network environment, the application of artificial intelligence in computer network technology issues under the background of big data is analyzed. First introduce artificial intelligence and understand its development in the big data environment. Secondly, analyze the application status of artificial intelligence technology, and clarify the application direction in the field of computer network technology problem solving. Finally, it analyzes the expert system, artificial neural network technology, data mining technology, autonomous agent technology, security management technology, problem solving technology, expert knowledge base technology, and computer network fuzzy information processing technology. The purpose is to give full play to the advantages of artificial intelligence to solve problems and provide guarantee for the safe and stable operation of computer systems.

articleTitle: Research on Semantic Segmentation Algorithm Based on Deep Learning Control Tools
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Deep learning has made breakthrough progress in semantic segmentation, and convolutional neural networks are widely used in semantic segmentation. This paper studies the semantic segmentation algorithm based on deep learning control tool, uses deep convolutional neural network to extract low-level features, and extracts high-level semantic features through multiscale context information. On this basis, the fusion of low-level detailed information and high-level semantic information is achieved through cascaded convolution and attention mechanisms. The algorithm is tested experimentally using the controlled article data set. The results show that the semantic segmentation algorithm based on deep learning control tools has good image segmentation effect and can meet the actual needs of semantic segmentation of controlled tool image.

articleTitle: Design of Laboratory Cloud Visual Intercom Access Control System Based on NFC Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Nowadays, the commonly used laboratory access control system is unable to quickly authenticate a large number of identities due to technical limitations. In order to solve this problem, a laboratory cloud visual intercom access control system based on NFC technology is designed. Based on the hardware part of the original access control system, designed the hardware module of NFC card reader, door machine and indoor unit. Based on the designed hardware, the software part of the system is designed. In order to ensure the security of communication between cloud server and access control terminal, AES algorithm is used to encrypt the communication. The cloud platform is used to realize the function of the access control system, and the design of the laboratory cloud visual intercom access control system is completed. By testing the load capacity and operation sensitivity of the system, the superiority of the system performance is verified.

articleTitle: Interference Estimation and Rocevery in Transform Domain Communication System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: The wireless communication networks are highly vulnerable to various types of electromagnetic interference, which seriously restricts the communication effectiveness, and the interference estimation and elimination are much essential issues in wireless communications. To solve the multi-task problems of the diverse interference estimation and cancelation with in transformation domain communication systems, the iterative sparse learning approach for multiple interference recovery and elimination simultaneously is proposed in this paper, which achieves the multiple learning for measured signals and structured sparse learning method in the area of simultaneous interference mitigation with signal recovery. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithms achieve convergence more rapidly, and the recovery performances are more accurate than other conventional algorithms in the condition of spectrum sensing with consistency, respectively.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral image classification method combining fast guided filtering and spatial neighborhood information
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: In order to solve the phenomenon of edge pixel disorder and different spectra characteristics with the same object caused by traditional hyperspectral classification methods which only pay attention to spectral information but ignore spatial information, a hyperspectral image classification algorithm combining fast guided filtering and spatial neighborhood information (FGF-SVM-SNI) is proposed. The method first uses a fast guide filter to extract the spatial texture information of hyperspectral images after dimensional reduction by principal component analysis and keep the edge details, the filtered spatial texture information is combined with the spectral information to form the spatial spectrum information, which is then classified by the support vector machine. Then a kind of hyperspectral pixel neighborhood information is designed to construct hyperspectral spatial correlation information to reduce "pocking mark" phenomenon and further optimize the classification results. The experimental results in The Indian Pines data set and Pavia University data set show that the proposed method (FGF-SVM-SNI) is significantly more accurate than the SVM classification method using only spectral information, which fully demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the Protection of Strong Electromagnetic Pulse to Reinforce the Computer Interface
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: In recent years, due to the continuous development of electromagnetic pulse technology, information electromagnetic equipment such as magnetrons and electronic rectifiers have also been widely used in electronic information systems. However, in order to prevent hardened computers from being affected by strong electromagnetic pulses, we must have a full understanding of the main types of strong electromagnetic pulses and their corresponding frequency and time domain characteristics, and accurately grasp the coupling paths of strong electromagnetic pulses. In addition, we also need to take effective protective measures for its interface according to the specific structural characteristics of the hardened computer and the main way the hardened computer is damaged by the strong electromagnetic pulse to prevent the strong electromagnetic pulse from causing serious damage to the electronic information system.

articleTitle: Applications of New Technologies to Recognition of Financial Statement Fraud
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Financial statement fraud is one of common means of false accounting. Authenticity and reliability of financial statements are doubted due to fraud. Recently, it is very frequent to see financial statement fraud of listed companies in China and there might be more frauds which have not been exposed yet. It is urgent to develop technologies for supervision of financial statements and recognition of financial statement fraud. Using new technologies to recognition of financial statement fraud will bring a fresh reform to the auditing industry. More importantly, using new technologies will surely improve auditing quality despite of decreasing labor cost and time cost.

articleTitle: Analysis Of Fault Diagnosis Method Of Building Electrical System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Building electrical system is a kind of system to manage building electricity, which is an important system to ensure the normal realization of building function. Building lighting, elevators, and air conditioning are inseparable from the support of the building electrical system. Building electrical subsystems are large in number, large in scale, complex in systems, difficult to research, and have a high probability of failure, and the types of failures are also complex and diverse, so the building electrical system fault diagnosis technology is particularly important, building electrical, as one of the core technology of the whole building system, on how to use modern science and technology promote the reliability and stability of the building electrical system fault diagnosis put forward higher requirements. This paper introduces the composition of the building electrical system and the current domestic and foreign research results in building electrical fault diagnosis, and analyzes four methods of building electrical fault diagnosis, namely: fault diagnosis method based on signal processing system, fault diagnosis method based on analytical model, fault diagnosis method based on classification, fault diagnosis method based on knowledge, as well as their characteristics and application provide some reference value for future researchers.

articleTitle: Control of Whac-A-Mole game based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: With the rapid development and popularization of computer application technology, the network has also spread to every corner of our life, which brings great convenience for our study and work. Playing Games on the computer has also become mainstream. Whac-A-Mole game is a popular game in our life. At present, the software version of the Whac-A-Mole game is mainly written in Java, Android and other languages. It is rarely written in G language. Based on this, a Whac-A-Mole game written in G language on LabVIEW platform is been designed in this paper.

articleTitle: Robust Time Series Prediction with Missing Data Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) is a class of neural networks for processing sequential data. Accordingly, when we predict some long-term sequence information, such as the flight information within one year, we usually use the RNN. However, as a general recurrent neural network, RNN cannot deal with the temporal data involving a mixture of long-term and short-term patterns. Therefore, we adopt a new deep learning framework, that is, long- and short-term time series network (LSTNet), which is composed of CNN, RNN, skip RNN and AR component. On this basis, the existing LSTNet algorithm only uses the observed data to predict time series without considering the robustness of the overall structure. The prediction error will be greatly increased when some of the data is missing. In this paper, we propose a novel deep learning framework based on LSTNet network, namely Missing data LSTNet network (M-LSTNet), to solve the problem of time series prediction in the presence of missing data in LSTNet network. Compared with the original framework, we add two new algorithms, M-Impute and M-ARIMA. The algorithm M-Impute is used to judge whether the missing data has occurred and compensate the discontinuous time series containing missing data into continuous time series. The later algorithm M-ARIMA uses the time series predicted by ARIMA to replace the continuous time series obtained in the M-Impute so as to improve the original LSTNet framework and solve the negative impact caused by data missing. Based on the deep learning framework M-LSTNet in this paper, we calculate the prediction evaluation of the original time series, the time series containing missing data and the time series improved by our algorithms. The results show that, our compensation algorithm can obtain better prediction effect and improve the stability of the whole deep learning network.

articleTitle: Research on speech replay attack detection using approach of multi-feature and multi-classifier fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Replay attack detection is crucial to prevent security and reliability when the automatic speaker verification (ASV) systems encounter the spoofed attacks. In order to overcome the shortcomings of traditional cepstrum features can not effectively represent the difference between real speech and replay speech in low-frequency band. We proposed a novel low frequency cepstrum coefficient under singular value decomposition (LCSVD). In addition, an effective feature fusion method (LCSVD+CQCC) based GSV and RELIEF algorithm in the super vector space is studied to improve the performance of detection system. We also proposed to use an multi-classifier set, which includes Random Forest (RF) and LogitBoost classifiers. Experimental results have shown that the proposed multi-feature and multi-classifier fusion system can provide substantially better performance than baseline. EER of primary system on development and evaluation set are respectively 2.49% and 16.58%, compared to baseline 11.28% and 31.84%, which are also better than baseline 77.9% and 47.9%.

articleTitle: A Mode Study on the Integration of Computer Network Technology and College English Curriculum
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: With the rapid development of network technology, new vitality has been injected into China's education industry. The backward college English teaching mode in the past is difficult to meet the needs of students. In order to promote the sustainable development of college English teaching, it is necessary to organically integrate computer network with college English teaching, abandon the old teaching ideas, make full use of the diversified functions of network teaching, and arouse students' learning enthusiasm, so as to improve students' English listening and speaking practice ability. Based on this, this paper explores and analyzes the integration mode of computer network technology and college English curriculum.

articleTitle: Research on Market Development of Communication Operators Based on Internet Marketing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: The continuous development of my country's economy has driven the development of my country's mobile communications industry. At the same time, competition among mobile communication operators is fierce. All operators are seeking innovations in marketing strategies. They use diversified marketing methods and methods to achieve differentiated marketing and expand market share. The characteristics of network marketing with strong interaction, multiple users and wide audiences have made it a popular way of marketing and promotion used by modern enterprises. The scientific and reasonable use of network marketing by communication operators can help save marketing and publicity costs, better achieve marketing goals, and expand markets. Based on the relevant theories of network marketing, this article discusses and analyzes the network marketing strategies of communication operators for market development. The author of this article hopes that these strategies will help to develop the communications operator market.

articleTitle: Exploration on the Maintenance and Management of College English Autonomous Learning Center Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: In this paper, the author first analyzes the concept of college English autonomous learning center, then expounds the problems existing in the traditional computer room, and finally makes an in-depth analysis of the characteristics and advantages of applying cloud settlement in college English autonomous learning center, including a detailed discussion and planning on the simplified installation of software, the setting of network blacklist, multi-system management functions and the application of cloud terminals. Starting from the development status of college English autonomous learning centers and cloud computing in China, cloud computing is continuously upgraded and optimized to promote its application and development in the maintenance and management of college English autonomous learning centers.

articleTitle: Intelligent Sensing Strategy of Terminal Equipment in Power Communication Network based on Intelligent Optical Connection Box
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Based on the requirement to improve the real-time and comprehensive of power communication network monitoring, the intelligent sensing strategy for power communication network terminal equipment based on intelligent optical connection box is proposed. The overall architecture of intelligent optical connection box including power supply layer, data acquisition layer, business control layer and data transmission layer is designed which adopts the mainstream narrowband Internet of things transmission scheme. In addition, intelligent optical connection box layout algorithm and power communication network terminal intelligent perception strategy are proposed, which provide direct data support and auxiliary decision-making for the work of managers, thus reducing the complexity of operation and maintenance and the workload of operation and maintenance personnel. Finally, the effectiveness of the strategy is verified.

articleTitle: Group Communication for Configurable Virtualized Sensors in Cyber-Physical Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Great variety of sensors and actuators are organized in Internet of Thing (IoT). The Constrained Application Protocol (CoAP) is one protocol supporting resource constrained devices and easy integration with the TCP/IP standards. In this paper we present a novel approach and a new framework to use CoAP group communication to implement configurable virtualized Sensors in Cyber-Physical computing environment. Experiments show that the framework can supply the reliable communications in Cyber-Physical system, minimize the consumption of WSN as well. It offers an extremely high efficiency communication way for event-based message exchange application, and provides a customizable filtering mechanism for data sampling.

articleTitle: Method of internet service easy login application based on RFSIM
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Proposed a login authentication system and realization to a service website based on RFSIM, so that users can easily manage the daily use of the internet user account and password, ensure that the internet user account and password will not be forgotten because of an increasing number of network services. By secure and reliable network authentication, We can easily login on the service website.

articleTitle: Implementation of convolution neural network on GPDSP
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: With the rapid development of deep learning algorithm, convolutional neural network has been widely used in engineering. However, due to the huge amount of calculation, it is necessary to select the appropriate hardware platform to make full use of the advantages of the network and give full play to the performance of the algorithm; GPDSP is very suitable for deploying deep learning algorithm on it due to its advantages of architecture. This paper introduces the method of mapping convolution neural network on GPDSP, analyzes its performance, and expounds the advantages of GPDSP in computing convolution.

articleTitle: Discussion of the impact in Internet Finance Based on the Perspective of Network Economics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Nowadays China's economic development speed is accelerating, Internet technology has been gradually integrated into people's lives. The continuous combination of computer and control engineering has a very important impact on various industries supported by scientific algorithms .But for the financial industry Financial algorithm has changed a little on the impact of Internet. Under the concept of control engineering, Internet finance began to appear in front of people, which has a big impact on traditional finance. However, the current development of Internet finance is also constantly improving, there are still many places that need to be further improved. This paper first understands the content of Internet finance, then analyzes the problems of Internet finance from the perspective of network economics, and finally puts forward the corresponding solutions to the problems, which provides reference for the development of Internet finance.

articleTitle: An Authentication Scheme with Computable Password for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: With the development of wireless communication and mobile technologies, Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have been applied in many fields. However, due to the limitations of sensor nodes resource, traditional security measures do not apply to WSNs. Therefore, how to coordinate the efficiency and safety performance of WSNs has become a hot spot. Meanwhile, the widely used static password authentication have been proven to be insecure in recent years. In this paper, we propose a secure and efficient computable password authentication scheme for WSNs. Through a detailed comparison on security and performance, our proposed scheme can resist various attacks with less overhead.

articleTitle: A Multi-secret Sharing Scheme with Combiner Identification Authentication
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Verifiable secret sharing is a hot topic in the field of secret sharing, but many verifiable secret sharing can not share more than one secret at the same time, moreover, some existing verifiable secret sharing schemes can not achieve the fairness of secret reconstruction in asynchronous environment. In this paper, an improved verifiable multi-secret sharing scheme is proposed by using one-way Hash function and Lagrange interpolation formula. In the scheme we introduce combiner verification and recognition and make the combiner and participants authenticate each other. Participants can check whether secret share submission requests from effective combiner is true, and combiner can detect and identify the participant. Our scheme has the following characteristics: Multiple Secrets can be reconstructed at the same time, and no safe channel is needed between the secret distributor and the participants, most importantly, our scheme adds validation to the combiner by the participants, making it impossible for an attacker to obtain information by impersonating the combiner.

articleTitle: Research and application of Chinese Entity Relation Extraction Based on Cyberspace Security
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Entity relation extraction has played an important role in the construction of semantic knowledge and knowledge graph, Chinese domain entity relation extraction has become more and more important as well. In order to improve the accuracy and practicality, we propose a Chinese entity relation extraction model based on deep neural network, which named BBCM(Bert-BiLSTM-CRF Model). The model uses the Bert language pre-training model to embed words in the corpus data, combines self-labeled "cyberspace security" field data to fine- tune parameters, which improves the model's ability to extract semantic features. The BiLSTM layer in the model can effectively memorize the contextual semantic information of the data, and combine the CRF loss function to obtain the optimal prediction relation. On the experiment of the standard dataset, the BBCM model has a significant improvement(F1 value reached 0.9544) than the baseline model. 7749 items are valid data after verification, and the application effect is obvious.

articleTitle: An Improved k-Means Methods for Cloud Computing based Coding Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: With the popularity of cloud computing and big data techniques, the coding environment has been integrated into a big data environment based on cloud computing. In order to better handle the coding data in the cloud computing based big data environment, there are two main problems should be solved. One problem is that the tasks' quantities cannot be met by the traditional one-dimensional search algorithm. The other problem is that different tasks have different requirements. Then, in this paper, a new clustering algorithm in the coding big data environment is proposed. Firstly, the clustering is added to the big data environment and use the clustering to deal with the code nodes in the big data environment. Secondly, different weights are assigned to different tasks to achieve efficient scheduling of the big data environment.

articleTitle: An Exploration and Analysis of the Internet Celebrity Marketing Mode under the Self-Media Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: As an emerging marketing model, Internet celebrity marketing has been widely adopted in the fast-selling industry. Most companies that can digest such a marketing method well have benefited a lot. This phenomenon shows that Internet celebrity marketing deserves attention and innovation as a derivative of self-media development. However, there are still some problems to be solved in the development process of Internet celebrity marketing, such as gaining attention by using vicious focus events, participating in vicious competition, poor marketing promotion methods of some Internet celebrities, and limited audience of Internet celebrity marketing. In response to these problems, in the future development process, it is required to pay attention increase supervision on the self-media platform and improve relevant laws and regulations. Enterprises should correctly choose "their own celebrities" and increase emphasis on Internet celebrity marketing.

articleTitle: Research on the Gradual Intelligence of Industrial Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: This article analyzes the application of Industrial Internet of Things in production links, supply chains, energy management, and management decision-making. The content of this paper includes the formulation of long-term planning, the application of edge computing benefits, the use of perception computing, the design of intelligent management systems, the design of security management modules, and the use of digital management information. The author combines the key points of the intelligent transformation of the Industrial Internet of Things, and studies the intelligent development trend of the Industrial Internet of Things. The purpose of this article is to accelerate the development of the intelligent industrial Internet of Things and promote the sustainable development of the industry economy.

articleTitle: Models and Modeling Techniques in the Industrial Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: From a systematic perspective, Industrial Internet involves five kinds of industrial models, including object information model, mechanism model, data-driven model, mixed model and simulation model. Firstly, the contents of five kinds of industrial models and the relationships between them are introduced. Secondly, the existing modeling methods in academia and industry are summarized from different perspectives, such as object information model, mechanism model, data-driven model, mixed model and simulation model. Finally, the development trend of modeling technology in the field of Industrial Internet and making the future research prospects are summarized.

articleTitle: Analysis of Database Programming Technology in Computer Software Engineering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: In the process of rapid development of information technology, the scale of the information industry is continuously expanding, which creates very favorable conditions for the construction and development of computer software engineering. In computer software engineering, programmers need to enhance the application value of programming technology, so as to ensure that they can meet the various needs of users. This requires programmers to study and analyze database programming technology based on computer software engineering. At the same time, the research is carried out from the computer software engineering technology form, analyzes various problems existing in the application process of database programming technology, and puts forward the key points of database programming technology application. Only in this way can we ensure that the functional characteristics of the computer database can be fully exerted, and promote the further development of my country's information industry.

articleTitle: Efficient and privacy-protected content-based image retrieval without homomorphic encryption
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Images play an increasingly important role in our lives as carriers of Information. At the same time, personal devices are increasingly unable to store and compute large amounts of images, so it is necessary to outsource to cloud servers. However, this also brings privacy issues, such as personal photos, medical photos, map mapping, etc. In this paper, we present a content-based image retrieval (CBIR) scheme that can be performed on ciphertext images. In order to better represent the Lage, instead of the traditional algorithms such as SIFT and HOG, image features are extracted using fine-tuned convolutional neural networks, and then outsources the encrypted feature vector and ciphertext image to cloud server. Considering the efficiency of the search, this paper uses the k-means algorithm to and local sensitive hash function to build a secure tree index. This paper proposes a new functional encryption of the inner product to calculate the Euclidean distance between the feature vectors to obtain the similarity between the images, and finally return the ciphertext image satisfying the condition to the user. The experimental results show the efficiency of our program, in addition, the paper gives security analysis to prove that our solution can against Chosen-Plaintext Attack (CPA).

articleTitle: Multi-authority attribute-based encryption supporting hierarchal access policy and range policy
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: Attribute-based encryption (ABE) is an appropriate technique to solve the problems of data sharing in cloud computing for the reason it can offer fine-grained access control. A large amount of data usually has a hierarchal structure, which can be leveraged to improve the efficiency of ABE. For some attributes which have numerical values, it is common to make a policy to determine if a certain number is in a given range. However, it is inefficient to trivially make an OR gate consisting of all the values in the range. Moreover, as cloud computing becomes more and more widely used, ABE with single authority is no longer applicable. Thus, a multi-authority ABE scheme supporting range policy is proposed. In the proposed scheme, there is one trusted central authority and multiple attribute authorities that manage different attribute domains. The shared data can be encrypted with an integrated access policy to save storage overhead and encryption and decryption time. Extension to range policy is realized by using classic segment tree. In addition, we prove our scheme is secure against CPA under standard model and analyze the efficiency of our scheme in comparison.

articleTitle: Research on Security Threat and Evaluation Model of New Energy Plant and Station
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Communication and Network Security (CCNS)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the scale of the new energy industry, the scale of new energy plants and stations represented by photovoltaic and wind power is growing rapidly, and the installed capacity will quickly replace the dominant positions of traditional energy sources such as hydropower and thermal power. Cybersecurity risks are also becoming increasingly prominent. Based on the asset composition of the new energy plant, this paper analyzes the possible attacks on wind power plants and photovoltaic power plants from the perspective of network, software, and personnel. It deeply studies the existing safety protection system of the new energy plant and station, and uses data analysis methods to identify unknown threats. At the same time, this article analyzes the threat model of new energy plants and stations, classifies the specific threats systematically, and implements the quantitative assessment of threats based on the threat assessment technology of the Semantic Web.
